content:
The story is great imo
A boy loses an important game and is invited to a program to make him the best striker in the world. He goes through multiple stages of games and loses many friends, growing as a player and person along the way. The theme of egoism is introduced, and the boy develops a ‘weapon’ that supports his ego

The sub voice acting is great, the dub voice acting on the other hand is ass

Season 1 animation is pretty good, season 2 is majority ass, and the final 2 episodes of season 2 is genuinely some of the best animation in anime
